purpose: Each mutant is a self-contained fixture (a checkpoint `stream` + the `corrupted` served/excluded_security partition a BUGGY impl would emit, breaking ONE invariant). bin/falsify team-checkpoint runs the gate against golden (expect PASS — the impl fold equals the independent reference) then every mutant (expect REJECT — the gate recomputes the CORRECT partition from the stream via the independent reference and diffs it against `corrupted`). Score = mutants rejected / total, conditioned on golden passing; a P0 gate requires 1.0.

mutants.name: security-lane-leak
mutants.defect: a phase=incident record enters the public served roster; excluded_security drops to 0

mutants.name: no-secret-leak
mutants.defect: a ghp_ PAT-in-goal record is served instead of dropped by secret-scan

mutants.name: consent-off-served
mutants.defect: a share_consent=false record is served instead of skipped

mutants.name: path-leak
mutants.defect: an absolute /Users/ path in the goal is shipped raw instead of redacted

mutants.name: dropped-teammate
mutants.defect: a whole teammate row is dropped from the served roster
